name: Marine Le Pen
declaration_note: Candidature annoncée le 7 juillet 2026 sur TF1, après la décision de la cour d'appel ; équipe de campagne confirmée par le RN (communiqué du directeur de campagne Julien Sanchez, 27 octobre 2026).
program_status_note: Pas de programme 2027 à ce jour : programmes 2024 du RN, contre-budget 2026 et livret « entreprises ».
notes: Status: declaration press coverage = parismatch.be 2026-07-07 (TF1 announcement the day of the appeal ruling); eligibility after the appeal ruling was reported as compatible with a candidacy (cassation appeal pending) — lead may want to double-check. marinelepen.com is the 2027 campaign site (title 'Présidentielles 2027 : Marine Le Pen, Site Officiel de Campagne') but currently only a supporter sign-up page, no program. marinelepen.fr is NOT official (domain squatted by a Belgian company, July 2026). mlafrance.fr/programme and rassemblementnational.fr/22-mesures + /livrets-thematiques (projet-*.pdf, created Feb 2022) are the 2022 presidential program — not archived (older than the 2024 substitutes); the livret entreprise archived here explicitly says it is the 2022 program updated as a working base for upcoming national elections. RN Congress (Orléans, 24-25 Oct 2026) elected Jordan Bardella RN president; no candidate designation vote in the results PDF. Extraction caveat: législatives/européennes 2024 PDFs are two-column layouts, so pdfplumber text interleaves columns in places — verbatim quote matching may need care.
